context.transcript:
To start today's staff meeting, I'd like to introduce nutritionist Catherine Hale.
As part of the company's wellness initiative, employees can meet with Catherine to discuss healthy eating, all free of charge.
I'll let her tell you more.
Thanks for the introduction.
I'm Catherine, and I'd like to help each of you develop a personalized nutritional plan to fit your life.
Does anyone have any questions before we start?
How can we make an appointment with you?
All appointments can be made online.
I'll send you an email later that will include a link to the reservation system.
context.transcript_translation:
为了开始今天的员工会议，我想介绍营养师 Catherine Hale。
作为公司健康计划的一部分，员工可以和 Catherine 会面，讨论健康的饮食，完全免费。
我让她来告诉你们更多信息。
谢谢你的介绍。
我是 Catherine，我想帮助大家制定个性化的营养计划以适应你们的生活。
在开始之前有人有什么问题吗？
我们怎样才能预约您呢？
所有预约都可以在线进行。
稍后我会给你们发一封电子邮件，其中会包含预订系统的链接。
